svg.text: Token Bucket: Idle Fills, Burst Drains, Refill Drips

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Bucket of 50 tokens, refilling at 10/sec. After 5 sec of idle the bucket is full; the next request can be a 50-burst,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: after which the client must wait for the drip refill.
